_comment: Not a full study - just demonstrates the dynamic image + preset features. Imagine a preseg.csv with columns: sid, img_t1, img_t2, img_flair, img_dwi, img_adc, mask (some may be empty per row).

images._comment: Opens ONE image per non-empty preseg.csv column matching img_*, for THIS specimen. A specimen missing img_dwi/img_adc simply won't get those images loaded; a specimen with 6 sequences gets 6 images. Column 'img_t1' -> image name 't1' (prefix stripped).

visual_presets._comment: Diffusion-related sequences as a named GROUP (list, not regex): different colormap + slightly higher default opacity if ever shown as an overlay.
